footer.risk: autonomous is an execution-only tool. Trading involves risk, including the possible loss of your entire investment. Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.

hero.body: provides the modular governance layer to transform AI from a decision support tool into a superior execution actor.

profit.intro: outperforms because every motion runs through watchlist specialized machine learning models, a nine-agent consensus-driven voting framework (Round Table V2), and a deterministic consensus gate — not a single LLM guessing the next print.

p1.text: Full performance history, time-series analyses, and a public test dashboard — every claim backed by data and traceable to the open-source community edition.

p2.text: The platform mirrors the structural risk controls of an institutional trading desk — deterministic gates, strict veto roles, and zero black boxes.

p3.text: The Platform's active and autonomous trading strategy outperforms the benchmark index whilst managing systemic risk limits within the user's deployment.

p4.text: Trades are strictly gated. Execution only happens when the weighted signal consensus crosses a fixed, hardcoded buy or sell band — no fuzzy drift, no override.

audit.intro: wraps unconstrained AI in a rigorous regulatory net, the dedicated compliance layer guarantees every executed trade is structurally safe for institutional deployment.

p1.text: Regulatorily relevant data lives on WORM databases — write-once, read-many, tamper-evident by construction.

p2.text: Every classifier's vote carries a written reasoning string; anonymous votes are rejected at the schema level. The pipeline is inspectable end to end.

p3.text: Anti-money-laundering screening, concentration-risk caps, market-abuse and trade-surveillance checks — applied synchronously before any order is routed.

p4.text: Triple-write audit chain captures every decision for your accounting and annual audits. Built to withstand institutional data standards.

safe.intro: turns risk control into a structural property — seven named layers, four synchronous gate checks, and a kill-switch that lives outside the trading pipeline.

p1.text: Each under formal change control. The daily-drawdown limit at 17.5% is sized for normal volatility — it trips on systematic failures.

p2.text: The pre-trade gate rejects orders that fail mandate, restricted-symbol, or concentration checks — no LLM, no async, no bypass.

p3.text: Trip, mass-cancel, manual reset. No timed auto-resume.

p4.text: System-wide capital protection is hardwired — the daily-DD halt overrides every individual signal before any one strategy can threaten the whole book.
